name: PLAY | 200mg Gummies | Berry Burst
description:
Get ready to Play harder with every bite. These sugar-coated Berry Burst Gummies hit with a sweet mix of juicy berries and a smooth, balanced high. Each piece packs 50mg of THC for bold flavor and an even bolder vibe.

Perfect for seasoned consumers who like to keep things sweet, strong, and on-the-go.

Flavor: Mixed berry

Texture: Sugar-dusted and chewy

Potency: 50mg THC per gummy (200mg total)

Vibe: Sweet, uplifting, and ready to Play.
